content: The contexts have the characteristic that each context contains a maximum of one pun BIBREF9 . In other words, there exists only one pun if the given sentence is detected as the one containing a pun. Otherwise, there is no pun residing in the text. To capture this interesting property, we propose a new tagging scheme consisting of three tags, namely { INLINEFORM0 }.
